scope: Final visible Draft; exact source/deployed/article/action bytes; all six reporting-window merges; trust-build roadmap and phase records; DailyLogger service recovery and review-history PRs; all-state same-source review searches; current review schema/discovery; and held-candidate custody. findings.title: Two of the six merges are omitted, including service code
findings.location: The opening (line 11) says the interval was planning/instrumentation and no DailyLogger draft queue moved; What shipped names only four of the stated six merges.
findings.explanation: The exact reporting window contains core #676/#721/#723 and DailyLogger #591/#594/#600. DailyLogger #591 added PostgreSQL-backed private-journal recovery, queue upgrade, fault handling, CLI/runtime code and tests in three commits, so the interval was not planning/instrumentation only.
findings.correction: Enumerate all six merges. Report #591 as substantive service code and #676 as the wayfinder merge; do not characterize the whole interval as planning/instrumentation only.

findings.title: The open service drafts are review history, not two merge chains
findings.location: Lines 98-99 and retained context call #576-#584 and #569-#575 sequenced chains whose base must merge before downstream PRs can move.
findings.explanation: DailyLogger #577 says it preserves the reviewed source histories through #584 and that the smaller PRs remain review history. #592 brought that integrated change to main. At the reviewed source #577 was closed, #578/#579 merged, and thirteen PRs in #569-#584 remained open Drafts as review history.
findings.correction: Say the reviewed changes are already on main through #592 and the remaining Drafts preserve review history. Do not propose resuming a predecessor merge chain or finding an unblock condition for #569/#576.

findings.title: PH8 owner work already has a canonical tracker and per-step issues
findings.location: Line 85 and the first held candidate say there is no checklist or single pointer for passkey/service-account status, propose a new tracker, and blanket-block PH8 code on owner decisions.
findings.explanation: Core #688 is the Phase 0 epic and ordered checklist. It links the authority-service account owner step, signing/passkey work, first-key/pinning and Face ID approval plus code slices and native blockers. Its order begins with code slice P0-PROBE, so it does not support a blanket before-any-code owner block.
findings.correction: Point readers to #688 and its linked owner-step slices, report each native blocker separately, and do not create a duplicate tracker or one blanket owner gate.
